proves.claim: The analysis result carries steps.startup as a whole number of milliseconds from process start.

cli.io-submit-gate-startup.the-result-ca.why: Without it, a regression where the analysis result stops recording its start-up time would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: Every other key of the analysis result is unchanged and steps.startup is no larger than the wall time around the spawn.

cli.io-submit-gate-startup.every-other-k.why: Without it, a regression where the start-up step changed the result's other keys or overstated the time would pass unnoticed.
